question: Does the fixed trained History2048 checkpoint gain detections or continuity from recurrent history at inference?

condition_meaning.HistoryCurrent: Same History2048 parameters, previous=X_t through the same PDA/TSFM
condition_meaning.HistoryOff: Same checkpoint, M1 residual including bias bypassed; original H enters frozen head

conclusion: History and same-weight current-only have identical target matches and continuity at the frozen threshold and O/S arrangements. The nine previously common recovered targets remain recovered without recurrent history at inference. Internal state and logits do differ, so this is not an absence-of-history claim.

common9.scope: Outcome-conditioned explanatory subgroup from completed v1, not an independent population estimate

same_weight_match_and_continuity.interpretation: History dependence does not change any matched target or recorded continuity metric versus current-only at these same weights, clips, arrangements and threshold. Background U is unchanged; History has 1/2 fewer outside-box positive pixels and 3/4 less unmatched-component area in O/S. Off restores archived release discrete diagnostics; box maxima have cross-runtime floating tails.

trace_aggregation.mean_order: ROI channel/pixel statistic -> overlapping-window mean per object/arrangement/kind/phase -> equal mean of available O/S arrangement means -> target-frame equal-weight group statistics
trace_aggregation.pooled_unique: Each object frame once; t0/t1_39 may have only one eligible arrangement, reported in arrangements_present
trace_aggregation.background_weighting: Target-paired fixed references; repeated physical background ROIs are not independent samples
trace_aggregation.missing_values: Average defined values only; counts recorded per object metric and group metric; zero is never substituted for undefined relative ratios

interpretation_limits: PDA-to-TSFM contraction is a measured stage association, not proof that the discarded direction contains useful target evidence.
The frozen head has nonzero local Jacobians and propagates differences; frozen parameters do not imply a blocked input path.
Same-checkpoint mode substitution is an inference dependence test, not a replacement for independently paired training.
The common9 subgroup is defined by completed v1 outcomes and is explanatory, not an independent population estimate.
Two development clips and actual-component diagnostics do not establish official Pd/Fa or generalization.

revision.only_candidate_change: M_t = A_t + TSFM(A_t, X_t), A_t=PDA(previous, X_t)
revision.planned_test: Original History continuation versus aligned-residual revision, 128 paired updates from the same History2048 checkpoint/Adam/RNG.
